question: One year ago, the ratio of the ages of Sara and Dipti was 3 : 4, respectively. Four years hence, this ratio would become 4 : 5. The present age of Sara is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio 1 year ago (Sara : Dipti) = 3 : 4

Ratio 4 years hence (Sara : Dipti) = 4 : 5

Difference in ratio parts (4−3) and (5−4) = 1 unit

Total time gap = 1 + 4 = 5 years ⇒ 1 unit = 5 years

Sara age 1 year ago = 3 × 5 = 15 years

Sara present age = 15 + 1 = 16 years

**∴ The correct answer is 16 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/189e3b5d84cbd448b9e3616291c62af9dbc8659b7cd898142d1d3091ba3e6efc.png] 

**Given:** Ratio of **Sara** and **Dipti** age 1 year ago = 3 : 4

Let their ages 1 year ago be 3x and 4x respectively.

⇒ Present age of **Sara** = 3x + 1

⇒ Present age of **Dipti** = 4x + 1

⇒ Ages after 4 years: **Sara** = (3x + 1) + 4 = 3x + 5; **Dipti** = (4x + 1) + 4 = 4x + 5

⇒ According to question: (3x + 5) / (4x + 5) = 4 / 5

⇒ 5(3x + 5) = 4(4x + 5)

⇒ 15x + 25 = 16x + 20

⇒ x = 5

⇒ **Sara present age** = 3(5) + 1 = 16 years

**∴ The correct answer is 16 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Ratio Difference Concept

If the **age difference** between two people is constant, the difference between their ratio parts must also be made equal across different time periods.

Cross Multiplication Method

For equations in the form (ax + b)/(cx + d) = m/n, use **cross multiplication** to solve for the variable x quickly.

Age Problems Logic

If 'n' years ago age was A, then **Present Age** = A + n. If 'm' years hence age will be B, then **Present Age** = B − m.</p
